# anthropic_workspace_rate_limits (Data Source)

Rate limit overrides configured for a workspace. Only limiters that override the organization value are returned. Read-only. Requires `admin_api_key` or `oauth_token`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "anthropic_workspace_rate_limits" "production" {
  workspace_id = anthropic_workspace.production.id
  group_type   = "model_group"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `workspace_id` (String) Workspace id.

### Optional

- `group_type` (String) Filter by group type.

### Read-Only

- `rate_limits` (Attributes List) Workspace rate limit overrides. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--rate_limits))

<a id="nestedatt--rate_limits"></a>
### Nested Schema for `rate_limits`

Read-Only:

- `group_type` (String) Group type.
- `limits` (Attributes List) Overridden limiters. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--rate_limits--limits))
- `models` (List of String) Models in the group, if any.
- `rate_limit_id` (String) Id of the organization rate limit group.

<a id="nestedatt--rate_limits--limits"></a>
### Nested Schema for `rate_limits.limits`

Read-Only:

- `org_limit` (Number) Organization limit value, if reported.
- `type` (String) Limiter type.
- `value` (Number) Workspace limit value.
